items.claim: CFO 上調 2026 全年營收指引區間
items.quote: revenues to range between $39.3 billion and $39.7 billion
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 給出全年調整後 EPS 指引區間
items.quote: adjusted EPS to range between $16.45 and $16.95
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 新指引內含四家併購的營收貢獻
items.quote: $1.2 billion to $1.4 billion of revenues
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 新指引內含四家併購的調整後 EBITDA 貢獻
items.quote: $120 million to $140 million of adjusted EBITDA
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明負債對 EBITDA 比率自 2025 年底 1.95 降至 1.7
items.quote: our debt-to-EBITDA ratio improved to 1.7,
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 表示下半年毛利率仍有上行空間，且指引採保守做法
items.quote: So yes, I think there's upside in the back.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 重申電力部門利潤率能力的口徑（10 至 12，12 為上限）
items.quote: the electric segment has the ability to operate 10 to 12
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 答覆地下與基礎建設部門利潤率可能追上電力部門，先求達雙位數
items.quote: let me get to double digits first
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱地下部門有機會與電力部門持平，取決於工作組合
items.quote: I do think we have opportunities to get at parity
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 答覆本季無一次性項目（回應 SunZia 結算問題）
items.quote: There was nothing onetime in our quarterly
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱自由現金流轉換率口徑約 55%（Investor Day 提過 55% 至 60%），並認為今年可達區間高端
items.quote: rate of around 55%.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱合約條款對現金流與營運資金有利，且遍及各業務
items.quote: We are getting favorable contracting terms
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 回應部分公用事業自建燃氣發電的趨勢
items.quote: Yes, it sounds easy. It's not.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說明對複循環與單循環燃氣機組 EPC 的風險立場
items.quote: not willing to take the risk on the combined cycle side
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱 NiSource 相關工作大部分將於第三季進入在手訂單
items.quote: a significant amount of that will go into backlog
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 預期第三季甚至第四季在手訂單續創新高
items.quote: record backlog into the third and probably even into
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 描述傳統輸配電業務成長口徑
items.quote: upper single-digit growth in the business as it sits
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說明大型輸電專案預計進場施工的時間點
items.quote: second half of '27, you'll start to see us go to the field
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 給出科技業務占整體營收比重的口徑
items.quote: 15% of the business is technology, call it, 15% to 20%
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 說明資料中心專案列入在手訂單的規則
items.quote: we tend to put in things that have only LNTPs
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 回應紐約州資料中心暫停令對公司影響
items.quote: having a moratorium in New York doesn't bother me at all
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 否認本季有訂單提前拉貨
items.quote: nothing pulled in at all that I'm aware of
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱產能充足、無人力吃緊
items.quote: we're nowhere near capacity
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱近期不會看到技術工人供給過剩
items.quote: we're not seeing any oversupply of craft-skilled
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱每年訓練支出約 2.5 億美元
items.quote: we spend about $250 million a year in training
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說明併購節奏不均：上季 0 件、本季 4 件
items.quote: Last quarter, we did zero. This quarter, we did 4.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 表示不看 EBOS 類公司
items.quote: I'm not looking at EBOS companies
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說明垂直供應鏈投資將選擇性進行
items.quote: We'll be selective in how we invest there.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說明預製與整合製造面積擴增
items.quote: talked about having 7 million square feet
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 答覆 800 伏特架構相關招標尚未出現
items.quote: We haven't seen it show up.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說明管線業務預算內部設定的口徑，並稱已超過
items.quote: we kind of put $500 million in our head
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 答覆併購貢獻約為半年份，可自行年化
items.quote: It's about 6, 7 months worth of what we gave you.
items.speaker: CFO

qa_flags.question: Steven Fisher (UBS) 問長期利潤率上行空間，管理層過去對利潤率上行訊息偏保守
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 說下半年有 room、指引 prudent，但未給具體利潤率數字或長期目標

qa_flags.question: Chad Dillard (Bernstein) 問預製業務占 RFP 比重、5 年展望、勞動成本節省與價值定價
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 談面積與協作，未回答 RFP 占比、5 年展望，也未直接回答價值定價

qa_flags.question: Chris Tsung (Wolfe) 問收購標的年化 EBITDA 與購買倍數
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 要求分析師自行計算，未給年化數字與倍數
